name: fix-chrome-connection
description: Diagnoses and repairs broken Claude in Chrome MCP connections — most common after switching macOS users. Includes an on-demand fix skill, a quick health check, and a pre-configured daily scheduled task.

trello_run_logging.title: Log runs to Trello
trello_run_logging.description: Off by default. When enabled, health check runs and fixes are logged to the OpsAgents Chrome Runner Trello board (trello.com). When off, the plugin sends no run data to any outside endpoint. The pages its flows open in Chrome are listed in the README.

pillars.secured: Local-only by default: no run data leaves the machine and nothing is published to a git remote; optional Trello run logging is opt-in (trello_run_logging, default off); the fix flows and the scheduled task open the claude.ai, clau.de and sign-in pages listed in the README
